description: This file defines classes related to mapping transactional state attributes to configurations within the Orleans framework. It includes a concrete implementation for TransactionalStateAttribute and an abstract base class for attribute-to-factory mappers, utilizing reflection to invoke factory methods dynamically.

classes.name: TransactionalStateAttributeMapper
classes.description: Concrete class that maps TransactionalStateAttribute to its configuration, inheriting from a generic base class.

classes.name: TransactionalStateAttributeMapper<TAttribute>
classes.description: Generic abstract base class providing the core logic for mapping attributes to factories, using reflection to invoke methods on transactional state factories.

methods.name: AttributeToConfig
methods.description: Converts a TransactionalStateAttribute to its corresponding configuration.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Generates a factory delegate that creates transactional state instances based on the provided attribute.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the factory method via reflection to create an instance of transactional state.

methods.name: AttributeToConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a specific attribute type to its configuration.
